title: Why do Chinese Weightlifters look so good?
summary: NH explains that Chinese Olympic weightlifters look aesthetic not because of the snatch and clean, which are concentric-heavy and technique-driven, but because of relaxed bodybuilding sessions. Those sessions target the upper-body muscles behind aesthetics (pull-ups, raises, dips, direct ab work). Add their leanness and compact frames, and most of the look is achievable naturally.
claims: Whether Chinese lifters use drugs doesn't matter much: most of them look naturally achievable, and Lu Xiaojun's recent shrinkage may reflect stopping a cycle
Olympic lifts are concentric-heavy and technique-driven, with a fast descent into the catch, which minimizes the lengthening phase and makes them less optimal for hypertrophy than squats or bench
Olympic lifting still develops the upper back, shoulders and legs well, but it cannot explain the aesthetic upper bodies
Aesthetic physiques center on the upper body: shoulders, chest, abs, arms; Greek statues weren't admired for their calves
Chinese lifters do dedicated bodybuilding work (pull-ups, raises, dips) besides their main lifts; China has won 38 weightlifting golds, over double the USA
Their bodybuilding work is relaxed and social rather than maximal; smaller muscles just need training, not blood-from-the-eyes intensity
Isolation lifts give a break from heavy compounds, act as active recovery and round out the physique
Specificity matters less for bodybuilding than for weightlifting; varying exercises is fine as long as each hits the target muscle
True isolation is a myth, but you can bias a muscle by removing helper muscles, e.g. upright rows for shoulders
A six-pack does not mean a strong core; core-stability work is isometric, while sit-ups train the abs through full eccentric and concentric range, so compounds alone won't build abs
To grow a muscle you must target it specifically; a particularly developed muscle in a group always traces back to a lift aimed at it (Lu raises for Lu's shoulders and traps)
Leanness is the second key: lifters above the 89 kg class look fluffy, which is why many natural bodybuilders trade size for definition
Anabolic hormones make fat loss easier, which is part of why people attribute the lifters' looks to drugs
Chinese lifters are usually up to about 5'8"; shorter limbs and torso give better leverages and a more muscular look, which applies to most men
They are selected for athleticism, not muscle-building genetics, so their physiques are not mainly genetic
exercises: concentric and technique focused, so suboptimal for hypertrophy
build the massive upper backs of Chinese lifters
named after Lu Xiaojun; shoulders and traps
biases shoulders with few helper muscles
eccentric+concentric ab work for a six-pack, unlike isometric core work
